1.name: The Rebuild
1.ov: After key players depart from the team, Carlo Ancelotti paves a new path forward and steadfast striker Karim Benzema steps into the spotlight.

1.name: The Comeback
1.ov: The team set out to defeat Paris Saint-Germain. Midfielder Luka Modrić reflects on his journey to greatness.

1.name: Until the End
1.ov: Pressures mount and emotions run high while facing Manchester City. In the aftermath, the team make a final push toward the ultimate trophy.
